finding.claim: Catch-up gets OpenViking's side from one recursive fs/ls with server defaults and ignores has_more. In the installed OpenViking source (0.5.0, server/routers/filesystem.py and fs_service.ls), recursive ls stops at node_limit=1000 and level_limit=3, and the HTTP route has no way to raise level_limit. Any file missing from a truncated listing looks absent, so every pass rewrites it, one VLM call each, every 15 minutes, forever. Its stale copy is never deleted either. Today localstack has about 235 entries and only PNGs at depth 4, so this is latent, and it was not checked against the cluster's 0.4.17. The smallest fix is to fail the pass when has_more is true. Walking folders one level at a time is the full fix.
